West Leander’s Weslynn project targets 75 lots in its first phase.

Austin Business Journal reported Nov. 17 that Randolph Texas Development broke ground on Weslynn, a single-family development planned for roughly 700 homes at full buildout. The first 75 one-acre lots are targeted for late 2027.

The distinction for buyers: late 2027 is a target for lots. If you’re comparing this project with homes already on the market, ask for separate dates for lot delivery, the start of home construction, and move-in.
